title: Manus launches AI tools for workflow automation and creative asset #Manus #AIworkflow #AIdesign
description:
Manus revealed three practical ways to enhance productivity using its AI platform. Users can remotely control their computer via phone, generate marketing assets such as product shots and ad creatives, and build fully functional websites or apps without needing their own servers or domains.

The platform’s advanced AI transforms completed tasks into reusable skills, automating workflows and significantly reducing manual effort. This secret feature allows businesses and individuals to streamline operations and scale their productivity with minimal input.

Manus’s versatility addresses key demands in digital marketing, remote work, and app development, providing a seamless experience that combines creative generation with technical execution. The integration of workflow automation through AI skills represents a notable innovation in personal and commercial automation tools.
